method: Reviewed full draft against official Korea Policy Briefing, Korea Energy Agency, and Korea Electric Power Corporation guidelines. Verified humidity 40-60%, temperature 18-20C, wattage ratings (15W, 30W, 150W, 300W), tiered electricity calculation formulas, cleaning schedules, and safety instructions. All facts match official documentation.
renewalNote: 7-day validity renewal 2026-11-10 12:30 UTC (Pickle). Basis: post Markdown and research JSON SHA-256 unchanged since the original verification (verified again before renewal); all cited source URLs re-checked the same day - 249 of 266 URLs returned HTTP 200/203, 15 returned 403 from bot-blocking commerce sites (coupang.com, store.ohou.se, tokyo/toptirereview, agent.jinair.com) that open in a browser, 1 timed out (koroad.or.kr board view); CI 'Quality' gate (npm run gate -- all) passing on the same HEAD. No fact text was changed.
